stories_kpis.description: Démarrage du ramp-up progressif de la mine souterraine Grasberg Block Cave en mars 2026.
Signature d'un protocole d'accord avec le gouvernement indonésien pour prolonger la durée de vie des droits d'exploitation à Grasberg.
Avancées dans les technologies de lixiviation innovantes et projets d'expansion brownfield en Arizona.
Dépôt d'une déclaration d'impact environnemental pour une expansion majeure potentielle à El Abra, Chili.
Le revenu net attribuable aux actions ordinaires s'élève à 881 millions de dollars, soit 0,61 $ par action au premier trimestre 2026.

Citation: "Volatility in global economic growth, particularly in developing economies, has the potential to affect adversely". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.score_rationale: The company operates under strict environmental regulations and must manage remediation and site rehabilitation costs. Citation: "We are required to comply with a wide range of laws and regulations in the". Position: bas Item 1A.

risks.title: Risques géopolitiques
risks.score_rationale: The company's operations are exposed to geopolitical risks in countries where it operates, potentially affecting production and revenues. risks.summary: Geopolitical events and instability can impact operational continuity and financial performance

risks.title: Competitive Pressure

risks.title: Risques opérationnels
risks.score_rationale: Mining operations are exposed to operational risks including accidents, equipment failures, and production disruptions. Citation: "If any of the following risks occur, they may have a material adverse impact on". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Operational incidents and production disruptions could impact revenues and profitability

risks.title: Commodity Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on copper and other commodity prices, creating significant revenue exposure. Citation: "Volatility in global economic growth, particularly in developing economies, has the potential to affect adversely". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.title: Risques financiers et de marché
risks.score_rationale: The company faces financial risks including interest rate and foreign exchange fluctuations. Citation: "Financial risks Fluctuations in the market prices of the commodities we produce have caused and". Position: haut Item 1A.

company_description: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. engages in the mining of mineral properties in North America, South America, and Indonesia. The company primarily explores for copper, gold, molybdenum, silver, and other metals. Its assets include the Grasberg minerals district in Indonesia; Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, and Miami in Arizona; Chino and Tyrone in New Mexico; and Henderson and Climax in Colorado, North America, as well as Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The company was formerly known as Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc. and changed its name to Freeport-McMoRan Inc. in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona.
